title: IRC service: report: abuse reports from IRC
description:
Mark asked for these four on 2026-11-22, after the MIMID raw verb landed (a59a7497).

The service's own Limitations say reports have no command in v1, and abuse reporting is otherwise JMAP-only (Message/reportAbuse). Store::report(keys, reason, note) already exists and returns Reported. Work: 'report <#channel> <msgid>... [reason]'. Referencing a message from IRC is the only real work; REDACT already resolves a msgid to a store key, so copy that. A message that kept nothing (the user's own, or one stored before franks were kept) is ActionError::NotReportable and must be said plainly, not swallowed. Reason is the protocol-07 §5.9 AbuseType, 0 to 255, default 0 (no codes defined yet, decision mimid-1wgh.5.32); a trailing note is at most MAX_NOTE_LEN octets.
close_reason: Landed c68fb00e and pushed, with a test over both the service nick and the MIMID verb.
